During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]], a secret Imperial '''listening post''' was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Nal Yeshu]] in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]]. The [[Listening post/Legends|listening post]] was [[Attack on Nal Yeshu|destroyed]] by local [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] that had been hired by the Republic.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Dead Silence}}</ref>
